A filling bar above each robot shows its windup. Jump over its shot; recovery is your opening. Hold Fire to shoot. On solid ground, Down holds a stationary duck and stops gunfire.


The posse meter refills automatically during play (12 seconds). Press C when it says READY. The posse dismantles every visible robot except Mother. No eligible robot on screen? Keep the charge.

Find ready-to-throw firebomb bottles. Each pickup adds one bottle; carry up to three. Press F to throw one. Bottles remain available when your inventory is full.


On your FM-1
First two white keys: left and right.
Third white key from the right: drop / duck.
Last two white keys: jump and fire.
First black key: enter / exit doors.
Rightmost black key: firebomb.
Second black key from the right: posse.
Play/Stop: pause menu. SAVE: save.


Menu: turn the Select knob and press SEL to confirm; Play returns. In the browser, use left/right arrows and Enter. Save keeps your current progress. Retry returns to the latest marked checkpoint and ends flawless eligibility. The dam builds continuously during a 22-second defense. After the outer city, chase and smash ten fleeing ground-robot groups and ride two ramps on the short motorbike run. Both ground robots and flying heads explode on bike contact without hurting you. Jumping is optional. E enters side rooms. At the end of the inner city, climb to the rooftop jetpack. Flight moves forward automatically: hold Jump to climb, release to descend, and shoot or dodge the incoming heads. Landing leads through the roof into the data center. Pause shows flawless eligibility. A New Run with no damage or retry and every enemy destroyed, including both side rooms, unlocks Golden Beaver. Jump/Fire confirms the unlock page; release and press again on the party page to start a gold New Run. Pause and save before power-off to keep the unlock. Health logs restore one missing heart; the dam arena has two. Browser saves are separate from device saves.
